scripts.generate: npm run generate -w @tumpel/api && npm run generate:rust
scripts.generate:rust: cargo run --quiet -p xtask -- generate-api && cargo fmt -p tumpel-api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run clippy && npm run fmt:check && npm run generate:check && npm run surface:check
scripts.guest:build: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+crt-static" cargo build --release -p tumpel-guest --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
